recognize_zh: 低倍抹片中有許多中到大型、核不規則的非典型淋巴樣細胞，部分細胞質含嗜天青顆粒，並夾雜碎裂的核與空泡狀殘渣，提示伴有壞死的淋巴瘤；單憑此圖無法確立 NK/T 細胞譜系。
features: Numerous medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented or convoluted nuclei
Moderate amounts of pale blue cytoplasm; some cells contain azurophilic granules
Frequent smudged, crushed and fragmented nuclei suggestive of necrosis/apoptosis
Scattered clear vacuoles and granular debris in the background
Loosely clustered cells among red cells without cohesive epithelial groups
describe_en: Smear preparation at low-to-intermediate magnification shows a cellular population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, some containing azurophilic granules. There are numerous smudged and fragmented nuclei with background vacuoles and granular debris, suggesting necrosis. No cohesive epithelial clusters are seen. The lineage cannot be established morphologically at this magnification; immunophenotyping (cytoplasmic CD3, CD56, cytotoxic markers) and EBER in situ hybridization are required. Findings are suggestive of a high-grade lymphoma and compatible with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are usually agranular with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and are CD20/PAX5-positive and EBER variably negative, whereas ENKTL cells may carry azurophilic granules and are CD56+/EBER+.
PTCL-NOS can look identical but typically lacks the angiocentric necrosis-associated pattern and is EBER-negative with surface CD3 expression.
Reactive lesions show a polymorphous mix of small lymphocytes, neutrophils and histiocytes rather than a dominant population of large atypical lymphoid cells.
